Automatic logging settings

Choose a calendar and call types, then enable logging from now. Draft changes do not alter an active policy until applied. Calls during a pause require a historical import. Calendar providers may sync events to their accounts. Phone-state access supports prompt call-end wakeups; periodic recovery still works without it.

Delivery review and recovery

Review saved delivery records across all calendars. Times use the current device timezone. Checking only reads existing calendar events; it never creates or changes one. Suppression stops app retries and clears the pending personal payload while retaining duplicate protection. Calendar events remain untouched. Reapproval is a separate, explicitly confirmed action for never-attempted work.

Calendar read/write access is required. Permission changes do not confirm this insertion. Tap reapprove again to review the original event.
The explicitly reapproved event was saved and verified. Its receipt prevents another automatic insertion.

Pending payload expired — no insertion attempted

Pending personal event payloads expire after seven days from storage, checked on access and in bounded maintenance batches. Existing payloads of unknown age receive seven days from migration. Phone history dates do not determine this age. IDs, hashes, source facts and calendar events remain. Expired never-attempted work requires a confirmed import to collect fresh source data; it is never inserted automatically. Offline or inactive apps may defer clearing until their next check.
Clear expired pending payloads now
%1$d expired payloads cleared in this pass. More may remain. Receipt metadata and calendar events were retained.
